chunks: And in another report from Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Abū Bakr al-Ḥaḍramī, similarly to it, except that he said:
He says: “O Allah, I did not take what I took from him as betrayal or injustice, but rather I took it in place of my due right.”

key_terms.خِيَانَةً: betrayal or treachery in taking property unlawfully
key_terms.مَكَانَ: in place of or as compensation for

ai.seo_question: What should a person say when taking back something in place of a right owed to him?
ai.summary: This report transmits a supplication to be said when taking something as compensation for one’s rightful due. It emphasizes that the act is not to be done as betrayal or wrongdoing, but only as recovery of a legitimate right.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3700 - And in another narration from Yunus ibn Abdul Rahman, from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami, similar to the previous one, except that he said:
He should say, "O Allah (swt), I did not take what I took from him as an act of betrayal or injustice, but I took it in place of my rightful due."
